card.name: Decimal points inside numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point or a digit inside a long number, right before more digits, such as a percentage in a results table or an ISBN or phone number. The pole is strongest on the point in a decimal like 87.9 or 53.3%.

modes.label: Decimal point in percentages
modes.description: The period between digits of a percentage or rate, in a trial results table or an adverse-event sentence.

modes.label: Digits and hyphens in ISBNs and phone numbers
modes.description: A digit or hyphen partway through a long identifier code.

card.writes: It suppresses percent-sign tokens, so it steers the model away from ending the number with a percent symbol right after this point.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a number, such as a decimal point or a digit in an ID code, where the number is not finished yet.
